text: The Jal Mahal, also known as the Jal Mahal of Narnaul or the Water Palace, is a late 16th century palace, fortification, and artificial lake located in Narnaul, Haryana, India. Built by a Mughal governor of Narnaul, the structure currently serves as a tourist attraction.
best_time: October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks)
